basic_details.job_title: RITES Recruitment 2026: 20 Assistant Manager (Electrical) Posts, Apply by 22 Dec
basic_details.short_information: RITES Limited, a Government of India Enterprise, has announced the RITES Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026 for 20 vacancies in the Electrical discipline under Vacancy Code RG/53/26. Candidates possessing a relevant Bachelor's degree in Engineering with a minimum of two years of post-qualification experience can apply for this recruitment. Selected candidates will receive an attractive pay scale of ₹40,000 to ₹1,40,000 per month, along with applicable allowances and benefits.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Age, experience and all other eligibility criteria are counted as on 22 December 2026 . Application and fee payment close on the same day, so candidates are advised not to wait until the last moment.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Breakdown
content_sections.text: Of these, 4 posts are reserved for PwBD candidates on a horizontal basis: 2 for category b and 2 for category c.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility
content_sections.text: A full-time Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Power Supply, Instrumentation and Control, Industrial Electronics, Electronics & Instrumentation, Applied Electronics, Digital Electronics or Power Electronics Engineering, or a combination of these. UR/EWS candidates (and SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD candidates applying against unreserved posts): First class or at least 60% . SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD candidates against reserved posts: At least 50% . The degree must be from an AICTE/UGC-recognised institution. Sections A & B of the Institution of Engineers (India) are also accepted. If the marksheet shows only CGPA and the university has no conversion formula, 6 on a 10-point scale is treated as 60%. At least 2 years of post-qualification experience in electrical engineering fields such as railway electrification, general electrical installations, site supervision, power distribution, electrical machines, or construction and maintenance of electrical equipment in buildings. Training (except on-the-job), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship and PhD research periods are not counted . Apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961, in the relevant field can count towards the minimum experience.

content_sections.heading: Age Relaxation
content_sections.text: The following age relaxations are applicable over the maximum age limit of 32 years: SC/ST: 5 years OBC-NCL: 3 years J&K domicile: 5 years PwBD: 10 years, in addition to any SC/ST/OBC-NCL relaxation RITES regular or contract employees meeting the criteria: 5 years Ex-servicemen are covered under extant government orders. PwBD relaxation applies whether or not the post is reserved for them, as long as the post is identified as suitable. For this post, the identified categories are locomotor disability (OA, OL, leprosy cured, acid attack victims) and hearing impairment.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: SC/ST/PwBD candidates must pay the fee at the time of application, and it is refunded (less GST and bank charges) once they take part in the written examination or interview and their category certificate is verified. The refund goes to the source account used for payment. Fees paid in any other mode are not accepted, and applications without successful payment are rejected. For payment-related issues, contact the helpdesk at 011-33557000 (Extension 13221) or email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of three stages: written test, document scrutiny and interview. Total Questions: 125 objective-type questions Marks: 1 mark for each question Duration: 2.5 hours Negative Marking: No negative marking PwBD candidates get 50 minutes of compensatory time. Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for UR/EWS and 45% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD candidates against reserved posts. Based on test results and the number of vacancies, RITES scrutinises uploaded documents and shortlists candidates for interview. Original documents are verified before the interview. Candidates are called in the ratio of 1:6 to the vacancies. Technical & Professional Proficiency: 30 marks Personality, Communication & Competency: 10 marks Minimum qualifying marks: 60% for UR/EWS and 50% for reserved categories. In case of a tie in marks, the older candidate ranks higher. Candidates can take the selection process in Hindi or English. Appointment is subject to medical fitness.

content_sections.heading: Written Test Syllabus
content_sections.text: The written examination covers the following nine units: Electric Circuits and Fields: Network theorems, three-phase circuits, electric and magnetic fields. Signals and Systems: Fourier, Laplace and Z transforms, sampling theorem. Electrical Machines: Transformers, DC machines, induction and synchronous machines. Power Systems: Transmission, distribution, load flow, fault analysis, protection and HVDC. Control Systems: Transfer functions, Routh, Nyquist, Bode and state space. Electrical and Electronic Measurements: Bridges, instruments, oscilloscopes and error analysis. Analog and Digital Electronics: Diodes, BJT, FET, op-amps, logic circuits and microprocessor basics. Power Electronics and Drives: Thyristors, MOSFETs, IGBTs, converters, choppers and inverters. Application/Utilisation of Electrical Energy: Electrification, lighting, sub-stations, DG sets, solar, HVAC, lifts, fire alarm, CCTV, planning, estimation, installation, testing and commissioning.

content_sections.heading: Exam Centres
content_sections.text: The written test will be conducted at the following examination centres: Delhi/Gurgaon Kolkata Bangalore Mumbai Bhubaneswar Guwahati Candidates must provide two examination centre preferences while applying. However, RITES may allot a different centre. All centres except Delhi/Gurgaon are tentative.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Visit the Career section of the official RITES website at www.rites.com . Register and fill in the online application form. Note down the Registration No. generated. Upload all required documents under the "Upload Document" section: High school certificate (proof of date of birth) Degree certificates and all semester marksheets Percentage conversion document, if applicable EWS/SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD certificate, if applicable Identity and address proof PAN card Experience proofs in a single PDF in chronological order , including joining order, relieving letter, service certificate and pay slips. Pay the application fee under the "Make Payment" section and download the final application form. Keep a printed and signed copy of the application form to carry if called for document verification. An offer letter alone is not accepted as proof of experience . Hard copies should not be sent by post or courier, and each application is final once submitted. To apply for multiple vacancies, candidates must submit a separate application form and fee for each vacancy.

content_sections.heading: Service Terms
content_sections.text: One-year probation period, with a screening test before confirmation. Candidates may be posted anywhere in India or abroad. Pay is fixed at the minimum of the scale, along with DA, allowances, Performance Related Pay, medical facilities, HRA or lease accommodation, PF, gratuity and the post-retirement medical scheme. Candidates moving from 8th CPC CDA pay scales get one fitment only, with final fixation after the 4th PRC report is implemented, if applicable. Government or PSU employees must apply through the proper channel or bring an NOC at the interview to get pay protection.

content_sections.heading: Contact Details
content_sections.text: For recruitment-related queries, candidates can email [email protected] with the following details: Vacancy Code (VC No.) Registration Number Full name in block letters Registered email ID Emails without these details will not be answered. Any corrigendum or recruitment-related update will be published only on the official RITES website and not in newspapers.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Manager (Electrical) vacancies are there in RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 20 vacancies: UR 09, EWS 01, OBC (NCL) 05, SC 03 and ST 02. Of these, 4 posts are reserved for PwBD on a horizontal basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for RITES Assistant Manager (Electrical)?
faq.answer: The last date for online application and online fee payment is 22 December 2026. Applications opened on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for RITES Assistant Manager (Electrical)?
faq.answer: A full time Bachelor's degree in Electrical / Electronics / Power Supply / Instrumentation and Control / Industrial Electronics / Electronics & Instrumentation / Applied Electronics / Digital Electronics / Power Electronics Engineering, with minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience. UR/EWS need 60% marks or first class; reserved categories need 50%.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for RITES Assistant Manager (Electrical)?
faq.answer: The age limit is 32 Years as on 22 December 2026. Relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL, 5 years for J&K Domicile, 10 years for PwBD (in addition to category relaxation) and 5 years for RITES regular/contract employees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of RITES Assistant Manager (Electrical)?
faq.answer: The pay scale is INR 40,000-1,40,000, with pay fixed at the minimum of the scale. DA, allowances, Performance Related Pay, HRA/Lease accommodation, medical facilities and a superannuation package are payable in addition to basic pay.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for RITES Assistant Manager (Electrical)?
faq.answer: General/OBC candidates pay Rs. 600/- plus taxes as applicable. EWS/SC/ST/PWD candidates pay Rs. 300/- plus taxes as applicable, paid online with the application.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for RITES Assistant Manager (Electrical)?
faq.answer: Apply online in the registration format in the Career Section of the RITES website, upload the documents and pay the fee under the Make Payment section. Hard copies must not be sent by post or courier.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RITES Assistant Manager (Electrical)?
faq.answer: Selection is by a written test of 125 questions (2.5 hours, no negative marking), document scrutiny, and an interview. Final weightage is written test 60% and interview 40%.

faq.question: Q9. Is the RITES Assistant Manager (Electrical) job permanent?
faq.answer: The recruitment is on regular basis, with an initial probation of one year from joining. Confirmation depends on performance, document verification and clearing a screening test at the end of probation.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post, and will I get a refund of the fee?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for more than one post code, with a separate application and fee for each, at their own risk. SC/ST/PwBD fees are refunded after participation in the written exam/interview, less GST/bank charges.
